snippet.title: DIGGER | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Digg. Or Die. DIGGER. Only in theaters October 2. #Diggermovie



Academy Award winner Tom Cruise stars in Academy Award-winning filmmaker Alejandro G. Iñárritu’s original film “Digger,” from Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures.
The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity’s savior before the disaster he’s unleashed destroys everything.
Cruise stars in the title role, alongside Oscar winner Riz Ahmed, John Goodman, Oscar nominee Sandra Hüller, Michael Stuhlbarg, and Oscar nominee Jesse Plemons.  Robert John Burke, Emma D’Arcy, Burn Gorman and Sophie Wilde also star. 
Iñárritu directed from a screenplay by Iñárritu & Oscar-winners Alexander Dinelaris & Nicolás Giacobone, and Sabina Berman, story by Iñárritu & Berman.  The film is produced by Iñárritu, Oscar nominee Mary Parent, Cruise and Michael Sharp, and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Berman, Dinelaris, Giacobone, Jez Butterworth and Emmanuel Lubezki.
Joining Iñárritu behind the camera are previous collaborators Oscar-winning director of photography Emmanuel Lubezki; editors Conor O’Neill and Oscar winner Stephen Mirrone; Oscar-nominated costume designer Jacqueline West; Oscar-winning makeup and hair designer Alessandro Bertolazzi; and Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler; along with Oscar-winning production designer Dennis Gassner and production designer Richard Johnson, Oscar-winning prosthetic makeup designer Kazu Hiro, and composer Cosmo Sheldrake.
An Alejandro G. Iñárritu Film, “Digger” was shot entirely in VistaVision and will be released in theaters and IMAX® across North America on October 2, 2026, and internationally beginning 30 September 2026.  It will be distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures.

Witness a legendary, historic blockbuster in the Semi-Finals as England clashes with Argentina in this intense FIFA World Cup 2026 showdown, fully simulated in EA Sports FC 26! With a ticket to the grand World Cup Final on the line, the pressure and stakes have reached their absolute peak. England enters the pitch with a hunger for ultimate glory, looking to dominate with their physical power, elite tactical depth, and devastating wing play. Standing in their way is the reigning world champions, Argentina—a side fueled by unmatched passion, championship grit, and technical perfection.

More than just a match, this is a clash of world-class titans. England unleashes a terrifyingly dynamic attack led by the clinical finishing of Harry Kane, the explosive pace of Anthony Gordon, and the creative brilliance of Bukayo Saka. Meanwhile, Argentina counters with a devastating, star-studded frontline featuring the timeless magic of Lionel Messi, the lethal instincts of Lautaro Martínez, and the relentless, high-pressing energy of Julián Álvarez.

✅ Will England’s fierce attacking trio of Kane, Gordon, and Saka power the Three Lions into the final, or can Argentina’s powerhouse trident of Messi, Martínez, and Álvarez engineer another masterclass to keep their crown defense alive?

If you enjoy hyper-realistic match simulations and in-depth tactical storytelling, don't forget to hit the like button and subscribe to our channel for more World Cup 2026 action!

Official Release Date - July 24, 2026 on Prime Video India

About:
In a dysfunctional Delhi Government School, a laidback headmaster’s attempt at a fully paid Cambridge trip sparks a chaotic makeover attempt - forcing a ragtag team of teachers to fix the broken system, one blackboard lesson at a time.

Prime Video is a one-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one application available across several devices. On Prime Video, customers can find their favourite Indian and international original series, movies, TV shows, and more, across multiple languages – including Indian-produced Original series like Mirzapur, Farzi, Panchayat, The Family Man, Dhootha, Jubilee, Dahaad, Made in Heaven, Suzhal – The Vortex, Inspector Rishi, Poacher, Indian Police Force, Paatal Lok, Rainbow Rishta, Wedding.con; Original movies like Maja Ma, Ammu, Mast Mein Rehne Ka; popular global Originals like Citadel, The Lord of The Rings: The Rings of Power, Fallout, Reacher, The Boys, The Wheel of Time, Road House, The Idea of You; some of the biggest post-theatrical films; direct-to-service films such as Shershaah, Soorarai Pottru, Sardar Udham, Bawaal, Gehraiyaan, Jai Bhim, Jalsa, Sherni, Narappa, Sarpatta Parambarai, Kuruthi, Joji, Malik, Pippa, HOME, Sharmajee Ki Beti, and many more of such titles. Customers can also go behind the scenes of their favorite movies and series with exclusive X-Ray access. Prime Video is one benefit among many that provides savings, convenience, and entertainment as part of the Prime membership. For more info visit www.amazon.com/primevideo.

snippet.title: Ratha Jatra ra Gahana Katha | Ratha Patha Jagannatha | ରଥଯାତ୍ରାର ଗହନ କଥା | Namita Agrawal
snippet.description:
ହେ ଜଗତର ନାଥ, ମୋ କଳା ସାଆନ୍ତ! ଦୀର୍ଘ ବର୍ଷକର ପ୍ରତୀକ୍ଷା ଆଜି ଶେଷ ହୋଇଛି। ଯେଉଁ ପ୍ରଭୁଙ୍କୁ ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ ଭକ୍ତଟିଏ ଦିନରାତି ଆଖିରୁ ଲୁହ ଗଡ଼ାଉଥିଲା, ସେହି ଦୀନବାନ୍ଧବ ଆଜି ରଥାରୂଢ଼ ହୋଇ ବଡ଼ଦାଣ୍ଡକୁ ଓହ୍ଲାଇ ଆସିଛନ୍ତି। ଜାତି, ଧର୍ମ, ବର୍ଣ୍ଣ ନିର୍ବିଶେଷରେ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ନିଜର ଦୁଇ ବାହୁ ପ୍ରସାରି କୋଳେଇ ନେବାକୁ ମୋ କାଳିଆ ବନ୍ଧୁ ନନ୍ଦିଘୋଷ ରଥ ଉପରେ ବିରାଜମାନ କରିଛନ୍ତି। ସେହି ଅଲୌକିକ, ମହିମାମୟ ଆଉ ଭକ୍ତିରସରେ ଜୁଡୁବୁଡୁ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତକୁ ଦେଖି ଭକ୍ତଟିଏ ନିଜ ସାଥୀ ବନ୍ଧୁକୁ ଆକୁଳ ହୋଇ ଡାକୁଛି— "ଆରେ ଦେଖ୍, ଦେଖ୍... ଆମ ଦୁଃଖସୁଖର ସାଥୀ, ଆମ କାଳିଆ ବନ୍ଧୁ ରଥ ଉପରେ ବସିଛି!" ଏହି ଦିବ୍ୟ ଭାବକୁ ଅତି ମନୋରମ ଢଙ୍ଗରେ ବଖାଣୁଛି ରଥଯାତ୍ରାର ଏହି ଚମତ୍କାର ଆଉ ଲୋକପ୍ରିୟ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ— "ରଥରେ ବସିଛି କାଳିଆ ବନ୍ଧୁ ଦେଖେ ତାକୁ"।

ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ଗର୍ବ, ପ୍ରିୟ କଣ୍ଠଶିଳ୍ପୀ ନମିତା ଅଗ୍ରୱାଲଙ୍କ କଣ୍ଠରେ ଏହି ରଥଯାତ୍ରା ସ୍ପେଶାଲ ଭଜନଟି ଶୁଣିଲେ ଗରୁଡ଼ ପରି ମନ ଧାଇଁଯିବ ବଡ଼ଦାଣ୍ଡକୁ ଆଉ ଛାତି ଭିତରୁ ଶୁଭିବ ହରିବୋଲ, ହୁଳହୁଳିର ମହାନାଦ।

ହେ ଜଗତର ନାଥ, ମୋ କଳା ସାଆନ୍ତ! ଦୀର୍ଘ ବର୍ଷକର ପ୍ରତୀକ୍ଷା ଆଜି ଶେଷ ହୋଇଛି। ଯେଉଁ ପ୍ରଭୁଙ୍କୁ ଦେଖିବା ପାଇଁ ଭକ୍ତଟିଏ ଦିନରାତି ଆଖିରୁ ଲୁହ ଗଡ଼ାଉଥିଲା, ସେହି ଦୀନବାନ୍ଧବ ଆଜି ରଥାରୂଢ଼ ହୋଇ ବଡ଼ଦାଣ୍ଡକୁ ଓହ୍ଲାଇ ଆସିଛନ୍ତି। ଜାତି, ଧର୍ମ, ବର୍ଣ୍ଣ ନିର୍ବିଶେଷରେ ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ ନିଜର ଦୁଇ ବାହୁ ପ୍ରସାରି କୋଳେଇ ନେବାକୁ ମୋ କାଳିଆ ବନ୍ଧୁ ନନ୍ଦିଘୋଷ ରଥ ଉପରେ ବିରାଜମାନ କରିଛନ୍ତି। ସେହି ଅଲୌକିକ, ମହିମାମୟ ଆଉ ଭକ୍ତିରସରେ ଜୁଡୁବୁଡୁ ମୁହୂର୍ତ୍ତକୁ ଦେଖି ଭକ୍ତଟିଏ ନିଜ ସାଥୀ ବନ୍ଧୁକୁ ଆକୁଳ ହୋଇ ଡାକୁଛି— "ଆରେ ଦେଖ୍, ଦେଖ୍... ଆମ ଦୁଃଖସୁଖର ସାଥୀ, ଆମ କାଳିଆ ବନ୍ଧୁ ରଥ ଉପରେ ବସିଛି!" ଏହି ଦିବ୍ୟ ଭାବକୁ ଅତି ମନୋରମ ଢଙ୍ଗରେ ବଖାଣୁଛି ରଥଯାତ୍ରାର ଏହି ଚମତ୍କାର ଆଉ ଲୋକପ୍ରିୟ ସଙ୍ଗୀତ— "ରଥରେ ବସିଛି କାଳିଆ ବନ୍ଧୁ ଦେଖେ ତାକୁ"।

ଓଡ଼ିଶାର ଗର୍ବ, ପ୍ରିୟ କଣ୍ଠଶିଳ୍ପୀ ନମିତା ଅଗ୍ରୱାଲଙ୍କ କଣ୍ଠରେ ଏହି ରଥଯାତ୍ରା ସ୍ପେଶାଲ ଭଜନଟି ଶୁଣିଲେ ଗରୁଡ଼ ପରି ମନ ଧାଇଁଯିବ ବଡ଼ଦାଣ୍ଡକୁ ଆଉ ଛାତି ଭିତରୁ ଶୁଭିବ ହରିବୋଲ, ହୁଳହୁଳିର ମହାନାଦ।

snippet.title: प्यार तो होता है प्यार | Parwana | Alka Yagnik | Udit Narayan Songs | Ajay Devgan
snippet.description:
2000 के दशक का वह सुनहरा दौर जब संगीत सीधे दिल को छू जाता था। अलका याग्निक और उदित नारायण की मखमली आवाजें आज भी प्यार की परिभाषा को नया अर्थ देती हैं। फिल्म 'परवाना' का यह गीत 'प्यार तो होता है प्यार' उस दौर की सबसे खूबसूरत रोमांटिक यादों में से एक है। 



Credits :

Song: Pyar To Hota Hai Pyar
Album: Parwana
Artist: Alka Yagnik | Udit Narayan
Music Director: Sanjeev-Darshan
Lyricist: Sameer 



Lyrics :

na shahar me hua na hi ghar me hua
pyaar to bas hua ik nazar me hua
ye to aaye nazar dil ke paar
pyaar to hota hai pyaar, pyaar to hota hai pyaar
pyaar to hota hai pyaar, pyaar to hota hai pyaar
na shahar me hua na hi ghar me hua
pyaar to bas hua ik nazar me hua
ye to aaye nazar dil ke paar
pyaar to hota hai pyaar, pyaar to hota hai pyaar
pyaar to hota hai pyaar, pyaar to hota hai pyaar

har saans me ab teri baat hai, meri zindagi ab mere sath hai
tu ban gayi hai zarurat meri, tere liye hai mohabbat meri
maine suna isko tune suna, ye ishq hai dhadkano ki sada
dil pe chhaaya hai iska khumaar
pyaar to hota hai pyaar, pyaar to hota hai pyaar
pyaar to hota hai pyaar, pyaar to hota hai pyaar
sun mere yaara yaara yaa raa
sun mere yaara yaara yaa raa

aisa kabhi pehle hota na tha, mera chain to aise khota na tha
kaise huyi aisi haalat meri, paagal banaati hai chaahat teri
tujhko khabar na mujhe tha pata, is dard ki na koi hai dava
ham to rahne lage beqraar
pyaar to hota hai pyaar, pyaar to hota hai pyaar
pyaar to hota hai pyaar, pyaar to hota hai pyaar
na shahar me hua na hi ghar me hua
pyaar to bas hua ik nazar me hua
ye to aaye nazar dil ke paar
pyaar to hota hai pyaar, pyaar to hota hai pyaar
pyaar to hota hai pyaar, pyaar to hota hai pyaar

इस दिलकश गाने को सुनकर पुरानी यादें ताजा हो जाती हैं। आपको यह गाना कैसा लगा? अपना पसंदीदा रोमांटिक गाना कमेंट बॉक्स में जरूर बताएं। अगर आपको यह वीडियो पसंद आया तो इसे लाइक करें, दोस्तों के साथ शेयर करें और हमारे चैनल को सब्सक्राइब करना न भूलें।

snippet.description:
🌼 **जय जगन्नाथ! जय बलभद्र! जय माता सुभद्रा!** 🌼

भगवान श्री जगन्नाथ महाप्रभु की दिव्य कृपा और पावन **रथ यात्रा 2026** के शुभ अवसर पर प्रस्तुत है यह **Nonstop Jagannath Bhajan Collection**, जिसमें भगवान जगन्नाथ के सबसे मधुर, मनमोहक और भक्तिमय भजनों का सुंदर संकलन है।

यदि आप भगवान जगन्नाथ के सच्चे भक्त हैं और उनकी कृपा प्राप्त करना चाहते हैं, तो इस भक्तिमय प्रस्तुति को अंत तक अवश्य सुनें। इन मधुर भजनों के माध्यम से अपने मन को प्रभु के चरणों में समर्पित करें और भक्ति के आनंद में डूब जाएँ।

रथ यात्रा का यह पावन पर्व हमें प्रेम, सेवा, समानता और भगवान के प्रति अटूट श्रद्धा का संदेश देता है। मान्यता है कि श्रद्धा से भगवान जगन्नाथ का नाम स्मरण करने और उनके भजनों का श्रवण करने से जीवन में सुख, शांति, समृद्धि तथा सकारात्मक ऊर्जा का संचार होता है।

🙏 **भगवान श्री जगन्नाथ महाप्रभु आप सभी पर अपनी असीम कृपा बनाए रखें और आपके जीवन को सुख, शांति, आरोग्य तथा समृद्धि से भर दें।**

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

👍 वीडियो को Like करें।

snippet.title: राम जी रहम करि (4K) #Mani Meraj, #Chand Jee, #Shilpi Raj | Ram Ji Raham Kari | New #Bhojpuri Song
snippet.description:
भोजपुरी जगत का एक और धमाकेदार और दिल छू लेने वाला गाना "राम जी रहम करि" अब आप सभी के बीच आ चुका है। इस गाने में भोजपुरी के मशहूर कॉमेडी किंग मनी मेराज (Mani Meraj) और चाँद जी (Chand Jee) का बेहतरीन अंदाज देखने को मिल रहा है। इस खूबसूरत गाने को अपनी जादुई आवाज से सजाया है ट्रेंडिंग सिंगर शिल्पी राज (Shilpi Raj) ने।

यह गाना आपको इमोशन, ड्रामा और बेहतरीन म्यूज़िक का एक परफेक्ट कॉम्बो देगा। वीडियो को 4K क्वालिटी में देखें और अपने दोस्तों के साथ शेयर करना न भूलें ! 

अगर आपको वीडियो पसंद आए तो लाइक करें, कमेंट करें और हमारे चैनल को सब्सक्राइब जरूर करें! धन्यवाद।

snippet.title: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS Official Trailer
snippet.description:
KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS in cinemas worldwide with limited screenings from August 12. 
tickets now on sale at http://katseyewildheartsfilm.com/

Two-time GRAMMY®-nominated global girl group KATSEYE is coming to cinemas worldwide with a special theatrical release ahead of their third EP, WILD.

KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is a captivating journey into the group's bold new era while celebrating the fans who helped make it possible. Featuring never-before-seen footage, EYEKONS fan videos, and intimate interviews from the group members, the film explores the powerful bond between KATSEYE and their global fandom. A love letter to the EYEKONS who helped build this movement, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS reveals why this group's story is only just beginning.

From the intense pressure of Dream Academy to chart-topping viral success, audiences experience the highs, setbacks, sacrifices, and breakthrough moments that transformed KATSEYE on their path to global pop stardom. Praised by outlets including The New York Times, Vogue, Rolling Stone, and Billboard, KATSEYE has earned acclaim for their relentless dedication to their craft and electrifying live performances. As one of pop's most exciting emerging global acts, the group continues to solidify its place as a worldwide force.

From the same team that created Netflix’s POP STAR ACADEMY, KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS is produced by Interscope Films and Boardwalk Pictures, in partnership with HYBE X GEFFEN, and directed by Nadia Hallgren.

snippet.title: Ratha Jaa Chali Jaa Chaka Gadi Jaa | ରଥଯା ଚାଲିଯା ଚକ ଗଡ଼ିଯା- RathaJatra Song | Namita Agrawal,Pradnya
snippet.description:
ବଡ଼ଦାଣ୍ଡର ବାଲି ଆଉ ଧୂଳି ଉପରେ ଯେବେ ନନ୍ଦିଘୋଷ, ତାଳଧ୍ୱଜ ଓ ଦର୍ପଦଳନ ରଥର ବଡ଼ ବଡ଼ ଚକ ଗଡ଼ିବାକୁ ଆରମ୍ଭ କରେ, ସେତେବେଳେ ସାରା ବ୍ରହ୍ମାଣ୍ଡର ହୃଦସ୍ପନ୍ଦନ ସତେ ଯେମିତି ସେହି ଚକ ସହ ତାଳ ଦେଇ ଆଗକୁ ବଢ଼ିଥାଏ। ଭକ୍ତର ଆକୁଳ ପ୍ରାର୍ଥନା ଆଉ ହରିବୋଲ ହୁଳହୁଳିର ମହାନାଦ ଭିତରେ ମହାପ୍ରଭୁଙ୍କୁ ଗୁଣ୍ଡିଚା ମନ୍ଦିର ଆଡ଼କୁ ପାଛୋଟି ନେବାର ଆବେଗ ହେଉଛି ଅନନ୍ୟ। "ରଥ ଯା ଚାଲି ଯା ଚକ ଗଡ଼ିଯା" — ଏହା କେବଳ ଏକ ଭଜନର ପଦ ନୁହେଁ, ଏହା ହେଉଛି ଲକ୍ଷ ଲକ୍ଷ ଭକ୍ତଙ୍କ ଭାବପୂର୍ଣ୍ଣ ଆହ୍ୱାନ ଆଉ କାଳିଆ ସାଆନ୍ତଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତି ଥିବା ଅବିରଳ ସମର୍ପଣର ଧ୍ୱନି।

snippet.title: Kalia Ki Sundara - Rapper Big Deal x Mrinmay MS | Rath Yatra Special
snippet.description:
Happy Rath Yatra 2026. Ama Jaga Asi Gala Puni Thare, ta pain ei gita, enjoy and Jai Jagannath🙏❤️

Music Produced - Rapper Big Deal
Traditional Section Produced - Mrinmay MS
Lyrics - Rapper Big Deal
Singer - Mrinmay MS
Label - Family Style Records, Pacific Music Group

Video Directed & Edited by THE RAHUL 
https://www.instagram.com/the_rahulcinematographer

Animation -  @TheHappySlate  
https://www.instagram.com/thehappyslate
Direction and Storyboards : Rakesh Nanda
Art : DVY, Anugraha Shaji
Animation : Bijendar Chhillar

Rapper Big Deal & Mrinmay styling/outfit - Orissa by Tania
https://www.instagram.com/orissabytania/

Cast:
Odissi Dancer - Arvi
Dancer - Annapurna Panda
Jagananth/Krishna Character - Aparna Panda
African Toka

Composer- Rapper Big Deal/ Samir Rishu Mohanty
Author- Rapper Big Deal/ Samir Rishu Mohanty
Publisher- Rapper Big Deal/ Samir Rishu Mohanty

#RathYatra #JaiJagannath #KaliaKiSundara #RapperBigDeal #MrinmayMS

**Hook:**
Tate chahinle, ki ananda,
Ei duniya ra sesa tu hi arambha,
Mo Kalia ki sundara,
Sabu bujhe mun, dekhiki toh nayana,

Jaga mo kehi na ta pari,
garba ki sie hela aamari,
Jaga mo sabu ta hata re, 
Garba ki sie ama pakhare,

**Verse:**
Bhai bhai, dekh asi gala jaga phere,
dhain dhain, bhakta asi gale puri tari,
pain pain, puni thare hela ratha jatra,
tain tain, khara mada kintu loko ratha,
tani tani, tama atma khusi haba taku,
chahin, chahin, tari bhali kehi duniya re,
kahin kahin? tari bhali kehi duniya re 
nahin, nahin, nahin, nahin, nahin

Bhetila, mo swapna ra Jaga mate,
Bhetila, ei gita mo dwara Jaga,
lekhila, moh maya au sabu sata,
bujhila, jie jie bhi ta nayana ku
Dekhila, kichi dini hasi khusi hei banchiba,
Ta pare gote sata, sabu mariba,
ta ratha bhali, sanga bas gadi chal, badhi chal, karma ta kari chal,

**Hook:**
Tate chahinle, ki ananda,
Ei duniya ra sesa tu hi arambha,
Mo Kalia ki sundara,
Sabu bujhe mun, dekhiki toh nayana,

Jaga mo kehi na ta pari,
garba ki sie hela aamari,
Jaga mo sabu ta hata re, 
Garba ki sie ama pakhare, 

**Verse 2:**
Khub bada lekhaka Balaram Das,
Lakhmi purana, bhakta toh khaas,
Ratha jatra dina bhuli jai, 
Sangere thile with Jamuna bai,
Mane padila ta bina bhabhi chinti
Doudi ki gale toh darsana pain,
Bina gadheiki, pana chepa thila gala re,
Nandighosa ku jai,

Ratha upare sie chadhile,
Rage re Purohita sabu jalile, kahile,
kou prakara ra bhakta tu,
Papi tu dura re raha ei ratha thu,
misiki pitile, marile,
Balarama nka hrudaya bhangile,
Sie banki muhana jaiki, ragiki, jaga ku dakile, kandile
Bali re ratha ku gadhile, kahile, toh jugu mada mun khaili,
Tate barsa barsa puja mun kariki,  apamana bhi sahili,
Jadi satere tu mo thakura, jadi satere tu mo sathi,
Ta Kalia ratha ku roki de, aji, hrudaya haba mo saanti,

Loko bhi tanile kafi,
Ta pare bhyabahara karile haati,
Kintu tina ti ratha au gadi lani, bada danda gale sie lakhi,
Raja nka Swapna re Jagannath asile, kahile Balaram moro bhakta,
Taku sanman deiki ana, nahale gadi bani jama ratha,
Uthiki, bujhiki sata, Raja gale Purohita nka saha,
Misiki magile Khyama sie Balarama nku, ta pare gadila ratha,
Bheda bhaba nahi, jati pati nahi, Jaga ku jebe bi daka,
Tame Khola hrudaya re daka, tama munda upare rahiba hata,

**Hook:**
Tate chahinle, ki ananda,
Ei duniya ra sesa tu hi arambha,
Mo Kalia ki sundara,
Sabu bujhe mun, dekhiki toh nayana,

Jaga mo kehi na ta pari,
garba ki sie hela aamari,
Jaga mo sabu ta hata re, 
Garba ki sie ama pakhare,

**Translation**:
When I look at you, what joy I feel,
You are the end and the beginning of this world.

My Kalia, how beautiful you are,
I understand everything by looking into your eyes.

Jaga, no one is like you,
How proud we are that you are ours.
Jaga, everything is in your hands,
How proud we are that you are with us.

---
## Verse 1
Brother, look, Jaga has come again,
The devotees have come running to Puri,
The Rath Yatra is happening once more,
The sun is blazing, but the people still pull the chariots,
Your soul will become happy by doing so,
Look and tell me who else is like him in this world?
There is no one, no one, no one, no one, no one.

I met Jaga in my dreams,
and he wrote this song through me,
attachment, illusion, and all truths of life, 
are revealed by looking into his eyes,
we are here for a few days on earth, lets smile and live more,
After that comes one truth: everyone will die,
So like his chariot, lets move together, move forward, and keep doing your duties.

---

## Hook
When I look at you, what joy I feel,
You are the end and the beginning of this world.
My Kalia, how beautiful you are,
I understand everything by looking into your eyes.

Jaga, no one is like you,
How proud we are that you are ours.
Jaga, everything is in your hands,
How proud we are that you are with us.

---

snippet.title: Teri Yaadon Ki Chadar Odhe Official Video Dil Ne Tera Naam Liya #bollywood #hindisong #2026
snippet.description:
Teri Yaadon Ki Chadar Odhe (Official Video ) (Dil Ne Tera Naam Liya) || Romantic Bollywood Hits Song 2026
Dil Ne Tera Naam Liya 2.0 💞 90s Bollywood Romantic Vibe | Soulful New Version

Song - Teri Yaadon Ki Chadar Odhe


तेरे बिना सूना है जहाँ, तेरे बिना तन्हा है दिल,
तेरे बिना हर धड़कन में, बस गूँजता है तेरा सिलसिला।
तेरी यादों की चादर ओढ़े, हर रात गुज़र जाती है,
तेरी तस्वीर आँखों में, फिर भी आँखें भीग जाती हैं।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

तेरे होंठों की मुस्कान में, मैंने खुदा का नूर देखा,
तेरे आँचल की छाँव में, सारा सुकून देखा।
तेरी आवाज़ में वो मिठास है, जो साजों को जगा देती है,
तेरी खामोशी भी अब तो, मेरी रूह को सजा देती है।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

कभी तेरी बातें याद आईं, तो दिल मुस्कुरा उठा,
कभी तेरी दूरी ने छू लिया, तो दिल बिखर उठा।
तेरे बिना जो जीना पड़ा, वो जीना ना रहा,
तेरे बिना हर लम्हा मेरा, अधूरा-सा रहा।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

तेरे जाने के बाद भी, तेरा एहसास रहता है,
हर शाम तेरी यादों का, साया पास रहता है।
तेरे ख़त के अक्षर अब भी, महकते हैं जैसे फूल,
तेरे नाम से ही चलती हैं, मेरी हर मंज़िल की धूल।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

तेरी आँखों में जो गहराई है, उसमें मेरा जहाँ है,
तेरे इश्क़ की पनाहों में, मेरी पहचान है।
तेरी राहों में बिछ जाऊँ, अगर तू मुस्कुराए,
तेरी ख़ुशी में अपनी हर सांस, मैं कुर्बान कर जाऊँ।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

कभी खामोशी में तेरा नाम लूँ, तो आँसू चल पड़ते हैं,
कभी तेरे ख़्वाबों में खो जाऊँ, तो लम्हे थम पड़ते हैं।
तेरे जाने के बाद भी, दिल तुझसे बातें करता है,
हर तन्हा रात में अब भी, तेरा ही ज़िक्र करता है।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

अब बस इतना कह दूँ तुझसे, लौट आ किसी बहाने,
तेरे बिना ये दिल मेरा, टूटे पत्ते जैसा दीवाने।
तेरे प्यार में ही तो मेरी, दुनिया पूरी होती है,
तेरे आने से ही मेरी, ज़िंदगी रोशन होती है।

दिल ने तेरा नाम लिया, हर साँस ने तेरा नाम लिया… (2)

About YRF Spy Universe: 
YRF Spy Universe is a first of its kind cinematic universe of spy thriller films in India. The first film in the universe, "Ek Tha Tiger", starring Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif was released in 2012, followed by its sequel "Tiger Zinda Hai" in 2017. The third film in the universe, "War" was released in 2019 and starred Hrithik Roshan and Tiger Shroff in pivotal roles. "Pathaan" was the fourth instalment in the Spy Universe franchise which was released in 2023 starring Shah Rukh Khan, Deepika Padukone and John Abraham. "Tiger 3", the fifth instalment in the YRF Spy Universe and the third film in the Tiger series, starring Salman Khan, Katrina Kaif and Emraan Hashmi, released in 2023. "War 2", the sixth film in the YRF Spy Universe, starring Hrithik Roshan, NTR and Kiara Advani, directed by Ayan Mukerji, released on 14 August 2025. "Alpha", the seventh film in the franchise and Hindi cinema’s first female-led YRF Spy Universe film, starring Alia Bhatt and Sharvari, released on 3 July 2026.

YRF Spy Universe is a first of its kind cinematic universe of spy thriller films in India. The first film in the universe, "Ek Tha Tiger", starring Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif was released in 2012, followed by its sequel "Tiger Zinda Hai" in 2017. The third film in the universe, "War" was released in 2019 and starred Hrithik Roshan and Tiger Shroff in pivotal roles. "Pathaan" was the fourth instalment in the Spy Universe franchise which was released in 2023 starring Shah Rukh Khan, Deepika Padukone and John Abraham. "Tiger 3", the fifth instalment in the YRF Spy Universe and the third film in the Tiger series, starring Salman Khan, Katrina Kaif and Emraan Hashmi, released in 2023. "War 2", the sixth film in the YRF Spy Universe, starring Hrithik Roshan, NTR and Kiara Advani, directed by Ayan Mukerji, released on 14 August 2025. "Alpha", the seventh film in the franchise and Hindi cinema’s first female-led YRF Spy Universe film, starring Alia Bhatt and Sharvari, released on 3 July 2026.

snippet.title: जाने क्यों लोग मोहब्बत किया करते हैं | Mehboob Ki Mehndi | Lata Mangeshkar Songs
snippet.description:
सत्तर के दशक की सुरीली यादों और लता मंगेशकर की जादुई आवाज़ में डूबा यह गीत 'जाने क्यों लोग मोहब्बत किया करते हैं' आज भी हर दिल को छू लेता है। यह गीत न केवल एक धुन है, बल्कि प्यार और विरह की एक गहरी दास्तां है जो दशकों बाद भी उतनी ही ताज़ा लगती है।



Credits :

Song: Jane Kyon Log Mohabbat Kiya
Album: Mehboob Ki Mehndi
Artist: Lata Mangeshkar
Music Director: Laxmikant-Pyarelal
Lyricist: Anand Bakshi 



Lyrics :

is zamane me, is mohabat ne
kitne dil tode, kitne ghar phunke
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai
dil ke badale darde dil liya karate hai
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai

tanhayi milti hai, mahafil nahi milti
rahe mahobat me kabhi manzil nahi milti
dil tut jata hai, nakam hota hai
ulfat ye logo ka yahi anjam hota hai
koi kya jane, kyu ye parawane,
kyu machalate hai, gum me jalate hai
aahe bhar bhar ke diwane jiya karate hai
aahe bhar bhar ke diwane jiya karate hai
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai

sawan me aankho ko, kitana rulati hai
furasat me jab dil ko kisi ki yaad aati hai
ye zindagi yu hi barabad hoti hai
har waqt hotho pe koi fariyad hoti hai
na dawao ka naam chalata hai
na duao se kam chalata hai
zahar ye phir bhi sabhi kyu piya karate hai
zahar ye phir bhi sabhi kyu piya karate hai
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai

mahabub se har gum manasub hota hai
din rat ulfat me tamasha khub hota hai
rato se bhi lambe ye pyar ke kise
aashiq sunate hai zafa ye yaar ke kise
bemurawat hai, bewafa hai wo,
us sitamagar ka apne dilwar ka,
naam le leke duhayi diya karate hai
naam le leke duhayi diya karate hai
jane kyu log mohabat kiya karate hai

इस सदाबहार नगमे को सुनकर पुरानी यादें ताज़ा हो जाती हैं। आपको यह गीत कैसा लगता है? अपनी राय हमें कमेंट में ज़रूर बताएं। अगर आपको यह वीडियो पसंद आया हो, तो इसे लाइक करें, दोस्तों के साथ शेयर करें और हमारे चैनल को सब्सक्राइब करना न भूलें।

Let the magic of music live on…

ଜୟ ଜଗନ୍ନାଥ!

ଭକ୍ତ ସହ ଭଗବାନଙ୍କ ମିଳନର ଏହି ତ ପବିତ୍ର ଦେଶ!

 मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा |Mohe Mor Banaiyo Radha Apne Vrindavan Ko|Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan#radha 
मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा | Mohe Mor Banaiyo Radha Apne Vrindavan Ko | Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan
मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा | Mohe Mor Banaiyo Radha Apne Vrindavan Ko | Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan

मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा | Mohe Mor Banaiyo Radha Apne Vrindavan Ko | Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan

Song: मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा | Mohe Mor Banaiyo Radha Apne Vrindavan Ko | Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan


Lose yourself in the sacred lanes of Vrindavan with this soulful rendition: "Mohe Mor Banaiyo Radha." This Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan captures the deep desire of a devotee to become a peacock in the gardens of Nidhivan, just to be close to Radha Rani and Krishna.

मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधा - वृंदावन की इस पावन धुन में खो जाएँ। Palak  Bhakti आपके लिए लेकर आया है श्री राधा-कृष्ण की महिमा का एक ऐसा भजन जो आपके हृदय को शांति और आनंद से भर देगा।

यह मधुर और भावपूर्ण Peaceful Radha Krishna Bhajan ब्रज की पावन भावना और राधा-कृष्ण के दिव्य प्रेम को समर्पित है।
“मोहे मोर बनइय्यो राधाअपने वृंदावन को” – यह पंक्ति भक्त की उस विनम्र प्रार्थना को दर्शाती है, जहाँ वह ब्रजधाम में मोर बनकर भी राधा-कृष्ण के चरणों में रहना चाहता है।

यह भजन ध्यान, जप, सुबह-शाम की पूजा, वृंदावन भक्ति, कीर्तन और मन की शांति के लिए अत्यंत उपयुक्त है। इसकी शांत धुन और प्रेमपूर्ण शब्द आत्मा को सुकून देते हैं और मन को वृंदावन की गलियों में ले जाते हैं।

Vrindavan Essence: Experience the 'Brij Ras' from the comfort of your home.

Soulful Peace: Perfect for morning meditation or evening relaxation.

snippet.description:

Music Composed and Arranged by : Pranam Kamlakhar
Vocals : Arunita Kanjilal ( Indian Idol Fame )

Lyrics in Telugu & English:
మహోపకారుడా - సజీవ దేవుడా 
వరాల యేసయ్య - సదా స్తుతించెద
తరాలు మారిన యుగాలు దాటిన
నీ ప్రేమ శాశ్వతం నీ ప్రేమ అమృతం

1. ఆరాధ్య దైవమా - అపురూప బంధమా 
నా హృదయ సీమలో- రవి కోటి తేజమా
ఎనలేని బాటలో -  వెనువెంట నీడగా
బలహీన వేళలో - బలమైన కోటగా
ఉన్నావు తోడుగా - నా ప్రాణ స్నేహమై 
కావాలి నీ కృపా - ఇల నాకు జీవమై 
నా నీతి సూర్యుడా - నా యేసు దైవమా
 నా జీవితాంతము - నను కాయు మేఘమా

2. నే కోరు సంపద  - నీ ప్రేమ కౌగిలి 
నీ జీవ వాక్యమే - నా క్షేమ లోగిలి 
ఊహించలేనుగా - నీ చేతి కార్యము
వివరించలేనుగా - నీ గొప్ప త్యాగము
సీయోను సారధి - నీవేగ మాదిరి 
విశ్వాస యాత్రలో - నా మంచి కాపరి
నా నీతి సూర్యుడా - నా యేసు దైవమా
 నా జీవితాంతము - ఆధార దీపమా

Mahopakaarudaa - Sajeeva Devudaa
Varaala Yesayya - Sadaa Stuthincheda
Tharaalu Maarina Yugaalu Daatina
Nee Prema Shaashvatham Nee Prema Amrutham

Aaraadhya Daivamaa – Apuroopa Bandhamaa
Naa Hrudaya Seemalo – Ravi Koti Tejama
Enaleni Baatalo – Venuventa Needagaa
Balaheena Velalo – Balamaina Kotagaa
Unnaavu Thodugaa – Naa Praana Snehamai
Kaavaali Nee Krupaa – Ila Naaku Jeevamai
Naa Neethi Sooryudaa – Naa Yesu Daivamaa
Naa Jeevithaanthamu – Nanu Kaayu Meghamaa 

Ne Koru Sampada – Nee Prema Kougili
Nee Jeeva Vaakyame – Naa Kshema Logili
Oohinchalenugaa – Nee Chethi Kaaryamu
Vivarinchalenugaa – Nee Goppa Thyaagamu
Seeyonu Saaradhi – Neevegaa Maadiri
Vishwaasa Yaathralo – Naa Manchi Kaapari
Naa Neethi Sooryudaa – Naa Yesu Daivamaa
Naa Jeevithaanthamu – Aadhaara Deepamaa
